description: This source file implements subtitle repositioning logic, utilizing OCR to adjust subtitle placement (top or bottom) based on detected burnt-in text in video frames. It includes functions for processing different subtitle formats (SRT, ASS/SSA, VTT) and integrating with a FastAPI backend, along with dependencies like OpenCV, numpy, and RapidOCR.

methods.name: detect_using_rapidocr
methods.description: Runs OCR on an input image using RapidOCR, saves visualization images, and returns detections.

methods.name: decide_subtitle_position
methods.description: Decides whether a subtitle segment should be at top or bottom based on detection bounding box positions.

methods.name: get_position_for_segment
methods.description: Samples frames within a subtitle segment, runs OCR, and determines position (top/bottom).

methods.name: reposition_srt
methods.description: Converts SRT subtitles to ASS format with alignment tags based on OCR analysis.

methods.name: reposition_ass
methods.description: Repositions ASS/SSA subtitles by updating alignment tags.

methods.name: reposition_ssa
methods.description: Repositions SSA subtitles by updating alignment tags.

methods.name: reposition_vtt
methods.description: Adjusts VTT subtitle line position based on OCR detection.

methods.name: process_subtitle
methods.description: Main orchestrator: processes video and subtitle files to produce repositioned subtitles.
